about_the_game:
PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: THIS GAME CONTAINS STROBING LIGHTS AND HARSH FLASHES. 

DISTURBING CONTENT: THIS GAME FEATURES DISTURBING CONTENT AND IS NOT SUITABLE FOR CHILDREN.

The old, unfinished Lily's Lil Games webseries is back, and recompiled for modern systems! In the second installment, you can see how the development of the DREAMCORE Engine (TM) was moving along and allowing FlashFire Games to develop more interesting web games!

NOW WITH 3D MINI-GAMES AND LESS LOOPING!

Welcome to Summer's family barn, where every day is a hard work! Lily has decided to help Summer out for the fall season and they hope to restore Summer's family business back to it's glory days!

Lily's job doesn't sound too hard:

  • 🥚 Clean the chicken co-op at night, and sort and deliver eggs by day. IN 3D!

  • 🥛 Maintain the Pasteurizer by night, and deliver milk by day. IN 3D!

  • 👩‍🌾 Prepare the emulsifier, and spooky text here by day. IN 3D!

  • 👭 Spend time with Summer and Mimi, Lily’s friends are all here!

Every day presents new challenges, new visitors, and new chances to help Lily restore Summer's family farm!

The farm is family!
And the dream never dies.

content_descriptors.notes: Disturbing images and sequences of death.

short_description: The old Lily Flash Games are being recompiled for modern systems! In Lily's Lil Barn Yard, help Summer restore her family farm! Clean the farm, and deliver the goods! Now with 3D minigames and all new Less Looping Technology! Help Lily become the best farmer she can be!
